products.text:
Type: framed typographic wall art
Use: decorating a wall; dining room, living room, home bar, on a wall above a sideboard or console
Style: farmhouse, rustic, industrial
Materials: printed canvas with distressed vintage finish, white wood frame
Colors: black, off-white lettering, warm white frame
Shape: tall vertical rectangle, stacked list of wine names in bold capitals, ornate crest panels at top and bottom, wide flat frame, slim profile
Feel: nostalgic, graphic, convivial
Goes with: reclaimed wood, black metal, white walls; farmhouse, bistro-style or industrial dining rooms

Type: upholstered lounge armchair
Use: relaxing, reading; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: mid-century modern, contemporary, modern
Materials: velvet upholstery with contrast stitching, black metal frame, brass-tipped feet
Colors: cool slate blue-grey, black, brass
Shape: high slightly flared back, wraparound padded arms, loose seat cushion, slim black metal sled-like legs with gold caps, medium size, enveloping yet raised
Feel: cozy, refined, calm
Goes with: walnut or light wood, brass accents, grey or white walls; mid-century or modern living rooms

Type: reclaimed wood coffee table
Use: holding drinks, books, decor; living room
Style: industrial, rustic, modern
Materials: reclaimed wood top with planked texture, brushed steel frame legs
Colors: warm mid-brown wood, silver grey steel
Shape: rectangular thick slab top, two U-shaped sled metal legs, low and long, solid visual weight, open underneath
Feel: grounded, warm, urban
Goes with: leather sofas, black or grey metal, concrete tones; industrial lofts, rustic modern living rooms

Type: velvet armless dining chair
Use: dining, occasional seating; dining room, home office, bedroom
Style: glam, contemporary, art deco
Materials: velvet upholstery, brass-finished metal frame
Colors: deep navy blue, antique brass
Shape: curved winged back, thick padded seat, slim rectangular sled base, compact, clean lines
Feel: luxe, elegant, rich
Goes with: marble or dark wood tables, gold accents, white or dark walls; glam or contemporary dining rooms

Type: slim LED table lamp
Use: ambient or reading light; on a nightstand, desk or side table; bedroom, living room, home office
Style: minimalist, modern, Scandinavian
Materials: powder-coated metal, integrated LED disc shade
Colors: pale blush pink, white
Shape: flat ultrathin disc shade, thin straight stem, round flat base, tall and slender, very light visual weight
Feel: soft, airy, playful
Goes with: white, light wood, pastel tones; Scandinavian bedrooms, minimalist home offices

Type: rustic wood TV console
Use: holding a TV and media devices, storage; living room, bedroom
Style: rustic, farmhouse
Materials: reclaimed pine with distressed finish, dark metal bar handles
Colors: warm light honey wood, dark iron
Shape: long low rectangle, open shelf with cable holes, four drawers, chunky block feet, overhanging top, sturdy and heavy
Feel: warm, homey, sturdy
Goes with: linen sofas, wrought iron, cream walls; farmhouse, cabin or rustic living rooms

Type: small oak side table
Use: holding a lamp or phone, small storage; beside a sofa or bed; living room, bedroom, hallway
Style: traditional, rustic, farmhouse
Materials: solid oak, metal cup handle
Colors: warm light golden oak, dark bronze
Shape: tall narrow square top with rounded edge, single drawer, lower shelf, four straight tapered legs, compact and light
Feel: warm, cottage, practical
Goes with: cream and sage tones, natural fabrics, oak furniture; country or traditional rooms

Type: drum shade pendant lamp
Use: general light over a dining table or room center; dining room, living room, bedroom
Style: modern, minimalist, Scandinavian
Materials: woven fabric drum shade, matte black metal rod and canopy
Colors: light oatmeal beige, matte black
Shape: wide round drum shade, diffuser underneath, straight black rod suspension, small round canopy, medium size
Feel: soft, calm, warm
Goes with: light wood, black accents, neutral walls; Scandinavian or modern rooms

Type: tall wood bookcase with drawer
Use: storing books and decor; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: mid-century modern, Scandinavian, rustic
Materials: solid wood with wire-brushed grain, textured drawer front
Colors: light greyish natural wood
Shape: tall narrow open frame, four shelves, one central drawer, splayed tapered legs, slim and upright
Feel: natural, airy, relaxed
Goes with: white walls, linen, black accents; Scandinavian or mid-century home offices

Type: wood dining armchair
Use: dining, working at a desk; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: Scandinavian, Japandi, minimalist
Materials: solid wood frame in matte black finish, woven paper cord seat
Colors: matte black, light natural beige seat
Shape: curved horizontal back rail, straight flat arms, woven seat, four straight round legs with stretchers, open and light
Feel: crafted, calm, graphic
Goes with: light or dark wood tables, white walls, natural textures; Scandinavian or Japandi dining rooms
